name: 242. Claude tool search replays its server blocks (tool search replay)
description:
Claude's server-side tool search returns a server_tool_use block paired with a tool_search_tool_result carrying the discovered tool_references, and Anthropic requires both to come back unchanged on the next turn (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/tool-search-tool).

On /v1/responses Bifrost returns the pair as a tool_search_call item (id/call_id srvtoolu_..., name tool_search_tool_bm25, tool_references). A client that sends that item back had it dropped: the JSON decoder kept only type/id/call_id/arguments/execution, and the request-path filter for OpenAI tool search items treated every JSON-decoded tool_search_call as OpenAI's and removed it. Upstream then saw only the tool_use/tool_result pair. The two /v1/responses pairs pin that fix.

The /anthropic/v1/messages pair pins the documented result shape end to end (#8502 moved tool_references into a tool_search_tool_search_result content object; the flat block with no content is rejected with 'tool_search_tool_result.content: Field required', #8291). Raw response echo is off so the reply goes through Bifrost's rebuild.

Each pair is a chain: turn 1 searches and calls the deferred get_weather and saves its output; turn 2 sends that output back unchanged and asserts a 200 plus the exact upstream blocks via raw_request.
